R3-M2 FIXED: artStage.show() takes a token (++showToken) and drops its layer after the awaits when a newer show began; lobby.js showSecretary is its only caller. Round 3's C2 repro (marumi-scene warmed, then aoi-archery, the hikari pictures delayed 1.2 s by page.route, pick hikari-rampart then marumi-scene 150 ms later) now ends on one layer marumi-scene, home.current marumi, secretary marumi, chip visible, at 1280x720, 768x1024 (her 3:4 full art) and 390x844. Six picks in one task end on the last; eight picks 40 ms apart with every .webp delayed a random 50-950 ms end on the last (1280x720, 768x1024, 360x800); a full pick still loading then a stand secretary (Rei) ends on Rei's stand.

Show token cannot leave the home stuck: the newest pick's picture aborted, or never answering, or aborted while an older slower pick is still loading: the home ends on the newest pick (the scene for the saved choice), one layer, .news-wait cleared, chip visible, no page errors, and the next pick shows normally (1280x720 and 768x1024). A pick then leaving for Missions 100 ms or 2.5 s into a 2 s load and coming back: one home, the picked picture, chip visible and lowered where it should be; a pick then leaving for good: no page errors. A superseded show returns false and only re-runs refold/syncLive on the current placement (both already run on every store change), so nothing is drawn for the old pick.

R3-L1 FIXED: lowerNews now measures the host's resting box (the slide-in transform is on the chip, not the host) at max(its height, --news-tall), growing upward when --news-up is 1, the same box uiBoxes counts. Round 3's B2 repro: a fresh load at 768x1024 with motion allowed on marumi-scene (3 loads) and kinu-scene (3 loads) has the chip lowered at reveal (the entrance animation still running or paused) and settled, her face core clear of it, all four icons hit-testable; the Reduce motion loads the same.

R3-L2 FIXED: setHidden(false) runs lowerNews, and drawAll ends with lowerNews. Round 3's D2 repro at 768x1024 (Hide UI from the menu, and by a long press on the wallpaper; resize to 1024x768; a store commit while hidden, which removes .news-down; back to 768x1024; restore): kinu-scene and marumi-scene end with the chip lowered (24,756,320x68), her face core clear and all four icons hit-testable.

lowerNews on every redraw: no flicker, loop or placement change. Per-frame samples (40 frames) across three store commits (one now, one next frame, one 100 ms later) at 768x1024, 360x800, 390x844, 844x390 and 1280x720 on the default stands of Marumi, Rei and Hikari and on kinu-scene, marumi-scene and hikari-rampart: one distinct state per case (the news host's box, .news-down, .fold, the picture's left/top/width, her figure's box, placement faceX/faceY/left/top all unchanged frame to frame and equal to before), and zero class/style mutations under the home in the 1.5 s after (no layout loop). On a stand, placement().scene is absent so lowerNews returns after a no-op class removal and never relayouts; the remove/measure/re-add on a lowered chip happens inside one task, so no frame ever shows it at the top.

.news-wait never stuck in any probe above (fast/slow/failed/never-answering pictures, races, many picks, leaving mid-load, hide-resize-restore) and never on the 11 x 5 illustration pass; e2e/home.mjs and e2e/lobby-illustrations.mjs agree.

The new e2e checks are sound: the tap-at-centre check runs over every full illustration at every default size (it would have caught R3-M1); the race check delays the wide hikari picture at 844x390 and asserts layer, home.current and secretary.
informational: Not from these commits (same code before the token): when the newest pick's picture fails to load, show() still swaps in its layer, so the home shows its dark ground with no picture (and no stand fallback) until the next pick or a reload. Under the token this is correct (the saved choice wins; before, an older slower pick could cover it with the wrong girl). A fallback to her stand on an image error would be a product choice, not a fix for this round.

As in round 3, display-only wallet plates (kind 'pill', not controls) touch the face core's edge in portrait (360x800 hikari-rampart, azami-scene, kinu-scene, marumi-scene; 390x844 marumi-scene); her eyes stay clear. Unchanged by these commits.
environment: 4 cores, quiet machine (npm test ran alongside the first two probe sections only; every e2e gate ran alone). Chromium headless shell via e2e/browser.mjs, SwiftShader.
